english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that two things are exactly the same, including abstract equivalents.

exampleSentences.english: The total on your quotation is identical to the total on our budget sheet.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你份報價同我哋預算表嘅總數完全一樣。
